purpose: Permanent discovery and priority registry for Islamic terminology, multilingual definitions, transliteration, glossary, and concept-reference sources used by @Rechercher.
required_behavior: Persist every discovered terminology/glossary source; never silently discard prior entries.
Search this registry before generic rediscovery for terminology, glossary, translation, concept, and definition requests.
Treat each language as an independent search lane and preserve source language and target-language coverage.
Keep provenance at term/entry level where possible.
Do not infer redistribution rights from public visibility; verify rights per source and per asset.
Prefer authoritative institutional or specialist encyclopedic sources over generic glossaries when ranking evidence.
Do not merge definitions from different sources into one authoritative definition without preserving attribution.

sources.name: Encyclopedia of Translated Islamic Terms
sources.notes: Core source requested by user. The site describes itself as a free electronic reference for translated Islamic terminology with definitions and multiple electronic formats. French and English interfaces were verified; multilingual term pages demonstrate broad language coverage.

sources.name: Islamic Content Encyclopedia / IslamEnc
languages: 100+ languages claimed by the platform; maintain current language list from live catalogue
sources.notes: Strong companion source to terminologyenc: multilingual Islamic encyclopedia with Quran, documents, encyclopedias, verified sources, and an API for developers.

sources.name: AZAN Islamic Glossary
sources.notes: Useful multilingual glossary with structured categories and hundreds of entries; retain as a terminology discovery/reference lane, not as a replacement for higher-authority sources.

sources.name: Iman New Zealand — Glossary of Islamic Terms in Arabic
coverage: 478 technical terms reported by the page
sources.notes: Useful supplementary terminology index; definitions and reuse rights must be checked at source level.

sources.name: MuslimWiki — Glossary of Islamic Terms in Arabic
sources.notes: Useful for spelling variants, transliteration variants, and concept disambiguation. Treat as a secondary discovery/reference source and preserve attribution/license metadata.

sources.name: Waqfeya — Foreign Dictionaries / Islamic Dictionaries Collection
sources.notes: Important book-level companion to live terminology encyclopedias. The collection includes Islamic-term dictionaries and Arabic-English/French-Arabic dictionaries. Use for bibliographic discovery and acquisition only after item-level rights verification.

ranking_rule: For terminology questions, search terminologyenc and IslamEnc first; then specialist multilingual glossaries and institutional dictionaries; then book/catalogue sources. Always preserve the original source and language for each definition/translation.
